summary: Artifact/memory architecture — append-oriented durable artifact ledger with real SHA-256 integrity, failure-record preservation, checkpoint links, knowledge→artifact traceability
implementation: electron/tenx/artifact-ledger.ts: TenxArtifactLedger — append-only (later failure never erases earlier success); real SHA-256 (node:crypto) over stored blob; recordFailure preserves failed runs; version counts per run across restarts; checkpointRef link on records; bySourceArtifact traces knowledge back to its source artifact; verify() detects tamper/corruption; durable ledger.json + per-artifact blob files
tests: tests/unit/tenx-phase-10k.test.ts (7 tests): full artifact metadata incl. sha256/version/provenance; append-only success+later failure coexist; failure-records never pruned by later success; sha256 verify detects blob corruption; checkpoint + knowledge-source traceability; durable restart + per-run version continuation; later write attempt never removes earlier records
notes: Shared tenx/artifact.ts keeps only the platform-neutral schema; crypto hash lives in the durable layer as designed.
